SpaceXAI: Grok Bot now lets you route egress through your local machine.
(It means Grok Bot's VM will connect to things from your IP address, not the datacenter's.)

This will be great to access picky sites and services that may block connections  from  datacenter IPs or access other services  that need to come from your IP.

Just go to  Settings > Computer >  Route egress  to enable it.  ( you may need to update Grok Bot's computer first  )
